Alex / Jordan — added RBAC export and quick telemetry note below. Dropping into the drive folder Alex mentioned.

Telemetry note (short):
- Default telemetry: request metadata (latency, model id, token counts), anonymized request hashes for dedupe.
- PII in telemetry: we do not persist raw request text to long-term telemetry. Short-term troubleshooting cache (KV cache) may contain raw inputs for 1–2 minutes and is not persisted to disk. If a customer opts into debug logging, we capture request text in a secure, time-limited bucket (explicit opt-in only).
- Retention: operational telemetry (non-PII) 90 days; debug buckets 30 days and subject to deletion on request.

RBAC export: attached (CSV) shows roles with read access to raw payloads: LegalOps (redacted), SRE, Oncall-ops. We also have a canary role that can request temporary access via Just-In-Time (JIT) with audit logs.

Kimberly Park
Privacy Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference
